verdict.rationale: Deel documents an official MCP server exposing contracts/people/payroll/time tools that can be invoked by Claude, ChatGPT, or custom agents, with OAuth2 auto-handled by MCP clients like Cursor/VS Code/Claude Desktop, and a probe confirms the live docs page. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party confirmation that the MCP server works in practice beyond first-party docs.
